get.description: Dashboard drill-down (/all-plan-vms/{status}): every VM across plans, optionally by status.

delete.description:
D24: in live mode a plan whose VMs were seeded has staging disks on the writer (or appliance). Deleting it
then needs cleanup=true, which removes them first (engine `cleanup`, target VMs are kept) and deletes the plan
when every VM is done; without it the call is refused instead of leaving disks behind.

patch.description: Change one VM setting of an existing plan without resending the whole plan (cbt, final_verify).

get.description: Same scripts without a plan, for the wizard before the plan is saved.
Engine log of one VM (live mode): every step's output, UTC timestamps.
Server-sent events: one 'change' message whenever any plan, environment or event changes.

put.description: Replace the UI certificate. nginx reloads it on the appliance (a systemd path unit watches the file).

Admin only (the role middleware refuses writes from viewers). Streams the bundle into the spool and asks
ev2ahv-upgrade.path (root) to apply it. Root re-verifies everything; nothing here is trusted.

vm_ids.title: Vm Ids
vm_ids.description: empty = every VM the action applies to

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: epoch seconds; null when unknown (plans stored before 0.3.x)

downtime_seconds.title: Downtime Seconds
downtime_seconds.description: source shutdown requested to target verified

verify.title: Verify
verify.description: power state and reachability seen by verify

CutoverResult.title: CutoverResult
CutoverResult.description: What the last successful cutover measured, kept on the plan VM (engine timings, in seconds).

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: plan-row Actions menu: Start, Edit, Delete

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: engine step running now, e.g. guest-prep, seed, resync, cutover

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: part of the cutover running now, e.g. final sync, image upload

sync_progress.title: Sync Progress
sync_progress.description: percent of the running sync pass (resync, cutover)

cutover_result.description: set when a cutover completes, cleared on rollback

linux_password.title: Linux Password
linux_password.description: write-only; ssh key is used when empty

virtio_source.title: Virtio Source
virtio_source.description: ISO path on the server, or a share the guest can reach

address.title: Address
address.description: everRun system (mgmt) IP, or Prism Central IP/FQDN

node_addresses.title: Node Addresses
node_addresses.description: everRun node IPs for read-only disk access

resync_minutes.title: Resync Minutes
resync_minutes.description: automatic resync interval while waiting for cutover (5 min or more)

Subnet.title: Subnet
Subnet.description: A Prism subnet (D8c): VLAN or OVERLAY (a VPC subnet); vpc is the VPC name for overlay subnets.

guest_address.title: Guest Address
guest_address.description: IP the server uses to reach the guest for automatic prep

cbt.title: Cbt
cbt.description: changed-block tracking for resyncs (experimental, everRun direct sources only; docs/cbt.md)

final_verify.title: Final Verify
final_verify.description: how the final sync checks the target after its source pass: full (hash the target too, default), sample (compare a random 1 percent), none (trust the recorded digests); docs/cbt.md
